view: top-down (bird's-eye) view of a house with two horses walking on the lawn below it; image +x = right, +y = down

camera.bg_shift_px_vs_frame0: below 0.02 px in x, constant 0.5 px y offset artefact of phase correlation (no motion)
camera.perspective: near-orthographic overhead view of the ground plane; the house roof is much closer to the camera than the ground, so its outline shows perspective (roof edges slant toward the apex at x~1025,y~19). Both horses are on the same ground plane at similar depth; one scale for the ground should apply to both.
